content: {"like":["Thrilling sci‑fi dramas with complex clones and identity twists (Orphan Black).","High‑concept psychological thrillers that explore consciousness (Ex Machina).","Classic holiday adaptations that capture the spirit (The Muppet Christmas Carol).","Well‑crafted prequel monster films with clever design (The Thing 2011).","Season‑one narratives that are surprising and tightly plotted (Orphan Black S1)."],"dislike":["Plot twists that undermine story coherence (Orphan Black S3).","Character arcs that break established traits (Orphan Black S2).","Unavoidable mind‑bending traps that feel inescapable (Predestination).","Filler scenes lacking purpose in later seasons (Orphan Black S2).","Slow, drawn‑out storytelling that underwhelms (The Frame)."]}
